Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard

SPECIFICATION FOR 
HARD METAL BURRS 

PART 3 CYLINDRICAL ROUND-{ BALL- ) NOSE BURRS ( TYPE C ) 

1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and requirements of hard metal burrs of cylindrical shape 
with a round ( ball ) nose. Type C. 

2. Dimensions 




All dimensions in millimetres

3. General Requirements — For requirements not covered in this standard it shall conform 
to IS ; 11 943 ( Part 1 )-1 987 Hard metal burrs: Part 1 Technical supply conditions. 

4. Marking — Shall be marked with the designation code and the manufacturers or trade-mark. 
4.1 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This Part 3 of the standard covers the hard metal burrs of Type C. The different types of 
hard metal burrs are covered in Parts 2 to 12 and the technical supply conditions are covered in 
Part 1 of this standard. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from 
ISO 7755/3-1984 'Hard metal burrs — Part 3 Cylindrical round (ball) nose burrs ( style C )\ 
issued by International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ).
